description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Conscripted Infantry, adding {C}{C}.
Conscripted Infantry dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Conscripted Infantry trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Conscripted Infantry from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
